decision.comment: Configuration replay is internally consistent and sound. No deterministic findings are present. Key verifications: (1) Model family is tiny_cnn (CNN), so transformer-specific fields (num_heads, patch_size, positional_encoding, tokenizer_layers, mlp_ratio, pooling) are correctly inactive and do not constitute a hybrid. (2) All augmentations in use (hflip, brightness, contrast) are built-in primitives requiring no extension approval; the pending hflip_only_aug extension is redundant and does not block replay. (3) The compact_conv_token_transformer extension is correctly gated pending hash-bound review and is not referenced by the current tiny_cnn configuration. (4) Test metrics are explicitly excluded from selection (test_metrics_used=false); selection rule is validation-only with test locked. (5) Normalization stats are computed from train split only (stats_source=train, train_stats_only=true), preventing leakage. (6) Split sizes (89996/10004/7180) match official PathMNIST; augmented train size 359984 = 89996×4 is arithmetically consistent. (7) Data audit passes all 11 checks with zero overlap, zero blanks, zero duplicates. (8) Validation accuracy 0.9910 and macro-F1 0.9909 are reasonable for a 3-depth, 96-channel CNN on 90K PathMNIST samples. Minor non-blocking notes: the architecture_research stage carries a revise action due to tangential prior-art citations and a null LLM model digest (qwen3.8/Oollama), which are traceability gaps rather than configuration defects; the 28×28 resolution ambiguity risks (background/debris/mucus, adipose vs. background, smooth muscle vs. stroma, lymphocytes vs. debris) should be surfaced via per-class metrics in downstream evaluation; the test set (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) originates from a different clinical center and must be reported as OOD/cross-center in final evaluation. None of these issues affect the validity of the current configuration replay. Proceed to training.
issues: Architecture research stage (prior) carries action=revise; its LLM issues (tangential arxiv_2508_18509v1 citation, weak ghostnet→class-imbalance bridge, null LLM digest) are traceability gaps, not configuration defects, and do not block the current tiny_cnn replay.

hflip_only_aug extension (spec_sha256=3541e66a…) is pending_review but hflip is a built-in primitive; the pending status is administratively redundant and should be noted to avoid confusion in the extension registry.

compact_conv_token_transformer (spec_sha256=4004d69e…) is correctly gated pending hash-bound independent review; no architecture change referencing it may be applied until review completes. Current tiny_cnn config is unaffected.
llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8 (Oollama) across all artefacts; LLM-component traceability is incomplete—recommend recording a verifiable model snapshot or digest in subsequent stages.

28×28 RGB resolution introduces documented class-ambiguity risks (background/debris/mucus, adipose vs. background, smooth muscle vs. stroma, lymphocytes vs. debris); downstream evaluation should report per-class metrics to surface these confusions.

Test set (CRC-VAL-HE-7K) originates from a different clinical center (official_test_separate_center=true); this OOD characteristic must be explicitly flagged in downstream evaluation reporting to avoid conflating in-distribution and cross-center performance.

request.system: You are an independent software and ML consistency reviewer. Inspect only the supplied evidence. You may raise severity but must never dismiss deterministic findings. No clinical claims. The supplied current UTC timestamp is authoritative. This pipeline uses the standard 28x28 RGB MedMNIST distribution; do not substitute the source-dataset or MedMNIST+ resolution. Only deterministic findings may justify action=stop; unsupported external-memory claims must be warnings requesting verification. ResNet18 has fixed topology; hidden controls base width and depth is ignored. Generic transformer fields are inactive for CNN families and do not make them transformer hybrids. Built-in augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90, rotate180, brightness, contrast) do not require extension approval; pending new proposals do not invalidate these primitives. A cited quote establishes traceability, not support for every scientific inference: assess that support separately. The OOD aggregate is the arithmetic mean of the selected score's AUROCs across corruption severities, not a pooled-sample AUROC.
